page.title: Model Explorer
page.introduction: The Model Explorer is a window for browsing every model you can open: the VCell database's BioModels, MathModels and geometries, and the BioModels Database. Its tree has the folders VCell's database tree has always had; selecting anything in it shows its details beside it.

appearance.para: Along the top are a Search field, a Filters button that shows the search options under it (where to look for the search text, the kind of model, its modeling approach, permissions, owner, when it was saved, and the order), and Refresh, which reads the database's lists again. Beside them, how many models and geometries are listed, and Tree and Table, which switch between the two views of them.
At the left, the tree. BioModels and MathModels are listed together, each marked by its icon. Each folder is arranged its own way:

list.item: My Models: your models, by name.
Shared With Me: models others have shared with you, by owner.

Public Models:
Published: models published with a paper, by publication, newest first (named by first author, year and title).
Curated: curated models, by publication, newest first; then Model Bricks, small curated models made to be reused as parts of others.
Uncurated: other public models, by owner.
Tutorials: the models VCell's tutorials use.
Geometries: My Geometries, and those Shared With Me and Public Geometries by owner.
BioModels Database: EBI's models, by name. They are found by their names and IDs only; those VCell can't import are greyed out.

appearance.para: A model saved more than once has its versions listed under it, newest first, with when each was saved and its permissions; the model itself stands for its latest version. Each folder, owner and publication says how many models it holds.

The Table view lists the same models without the folders' hierarchy, one row each, with columns for its Name, Type, the Folders the tree lists it in, Owner, when it was Saved, how many Versions it has, its Permissions, its Publication and its VCell ID. Click a column's heading to sort by it, and again to reverse the order. The search and filters narrow the table as they do the tree (the BioModels Database's models are in the tree only). What's selected stays selected when you switch between the views; opening, the right-click menu and comparing work the same in both.
At the right, the details of what's selected:

list.item: A publication: its details, and the models published with it; click one to select it in the tree, or double-click to open it.
A folder or owner: how many models it holds, and what the folder is for.
A BioModels Database model: its ID, web page, and whether VCell can import it.

operations.para: Open the Model Explorer from File > Model Explorer... or the Model Explorer button under a model window's navigation tree (both select that model in it, if it's saved), or from the Model Explorer button of the Welcome window. Right-click a model in the Welcome window's lists and choose Show in Model Explorer to open it at that model.

Open a model by double-clicking it (or one of its versions), by pressing Enter, or with the Open button in its details. A BioModels Database model is imported, as a new BioModel, the same ways (its button is Import).
Right-click a model for the menu the Welcome window's lists have: Open, Export / Save to File, Compare With, Copy Name and ID, and, for your own models, Permissions, Archive, Publish and Delete.

Compare With > Another Model... (from a model's right-click menu here or in the Welcome window) marks that model in the tree as comparing, and the bar above the tree asks for the model to compare it with. Select it and press Compare, or double-click it (or press Enter); Cancel or Escape stops.

Search: typing lists only the matching models, opening every folder down to them when there aren't too many; Escape clears it. A model selected from elsewhere that the search or filters hide clears them, to show it.
Closing the Model Explorer only hides it; it comes back as it was.
